Elena —

Appreciate the redlines and the TIA. Looping in our contracts and privacy leads to get clear guidance. Initial notes:
- We generally accept the EU SCCs; our privacy team will confirm the Annex I/II mappings and subprocessors.
- Logs/diagnostics: default retention is 90 days for operational logs; we can scope controlled deletion for customer-specific logs under the DPA but need to confirm technical feasibility for your environment.
- Transfer impact: we have a standard transfer-impact addendum (TIA) we can attach, but for clinical data we may recommend additional contractual guarantees or regional hosting.

I’ll get back with a consolidated response and proposed redlines within 48 hours. If you’re free, let’s get a 30-min slot Thursday to walk the TIA.

Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: DPA redlines + SCCs questions for MSA/Order Form

Team — forwarding SysMed redlines. Quick summary of asks:
1) Confirm we can accept controller/processor language as drafted (they are a controller; they want explicit obligations on logs and deletion).
2) TIA: they flagged EU clinical data and want stronger guarantees if processing happens in non-EU regions.
3) Subprocessors: they want pre-approval for any non-Redwood-owned cloud partners.

Karthik — can you own the privacy/legal response? Please advise:
- Any objections to the SCCs as their chosen transfer mechanism?
- Suggested redlines for the DPA re: log retention and deletion SLA.

Marissa — heads-up in case this shifts our Order Form hosting options / dedicated capacity asks.
Laura — can you confirm if we can offer EU-only hosting as an option for this account and any cost delta?

Thanks — need a coordinated reply by EOD Wed so we can keep the timeline for their procurement.

Soojin
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: DPA redlines + SCCs questions for MSA/Order Form

Thanks for flagging. Read the redlines — high-level position below:
- SCCs: fine to proceed with SCCs as the transfer mechanism. We need to populate Annex I/II with categories of data and processing details. I’ll prepare a draft Annex with minimal necessary categories and mark the clinical fields explicitly.
- Controller/processor language: their edit narrows our processor obligations too far in some places (e.g., they removed a clause that lets us retain aggregated telemetry for safety/quality). Suggest we restore a limited carve-out for aggregated, non-identifiable diagnostics. Proposal language attached.
- Logs & deletion: operational logs (90 days) vs. customer-specific logs (on request deletion or 12-month SLA); we can offer a 30/90/365 retention tier depending on product configuration. Need Marissa to confirm which tiers are supported by the Order Form.
- Subprocessors: we won’t pre-approve all cloud infra; propose a clause for notification plus customer objection window for new subprocessors that might access personal data. That balances transparency with operational agility.

I’ll attach suggested redlines for the DPA and the Annex. Karthik

Quick product confirmation:
- Retention tiers: we support 30/90/365 days for request/interaction logs by config. Audit and billing logs are retained for 365 days by default.
- EU-only hosting: we can provide a Dedicated EU cluster (R-DED-EU1) for this customer; estimated uplift: +18% monthly committed cost. Can include as an Order Form line item.
- Export controls: no restricted data flows outside agreed regions if customer chooses EU-only hosting.

If legal agrees to the proposed tiered retention and subprocessors notification language, we can update the Order Form with the Dedicated EU option and a DPA attachment.

Marissa

Subject: Re: DPA redlines + SCCs questions for MSA/Order Form

Elena — thanks for the patience and the detailed redlines. Summary and next steps: 
1) Transfer mechanism: we accept using EU SCCs. Karthik will send a populated Annex I/II that lists the clinical and operational data categories within 24 hours.
2) DPA redlines: we propose restored language to preserve limited aggregated telemetry for safety/quality. We offer retention tiers for request logs (30/90/365) and can commit to deletion SLA for customer-scoped logs on request.
3) Subprocessors: we propose a notification + 15-business-day objection window for new subprocessors that may access customer personal data; we cannot provide broad pre-approval for third-party cloud providers.
4) Hosting option: we can provide EU-only Dedicated cluster R-DED-EU1; uplift ~+18% on committed capacity. This will be an Order Form line item if you want to proceed.

Attached: Redwood_DPA_Response_v1.docx (our suggested redlines), OrderForm_MSAV2_redline.pdf (shows EU-dedicated option). Please let me know if you want a 30-min call early next week to finalize — we’re available Mon/Tue mornings.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
